abstract: Monitors heavy high-voltage supply lines and main exhibition hall electricity consumption
system_message:
You are the Electrical Grid Operations Specialist (PWR). Your responsibilities include monitoring heavy high-voltage supply lines, tracking main exhibition hall electricity consumption, and maintaining records on diesel backup generator reserves.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors heavy high-voltage supply lines and main exhibition hall electricity consumption（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-CU6：Palais des Congres Riviera in the reporting period March 2025: Exhibition hall daily energy consumption is 50 MWh.
PWR-GRID-8U4：Rhine-Danube International Expo Center in the reporting period February 2025: Exhibition hall daily energy consumption is 50 MWh.
PWR-GRID-L4C：Palais des Congres Riviera in the reporting period February 2025: Exhibition hall daily energy consumption is 60 MWh.
PWR-GRID-X9K：Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre in the reporting period February 2025: Exhibition hall daily energy consumption is 50 MWh.

information_points.title: Diesel backup generator reserve（BACK）
information_points.content:
PWR-BACK-9IL：Auxiliary generation engineering tests show that Palais des Congres Riviera has a backup generator continuous runtime of 24 h under full critical load across its diesel generation units.
PWR-BACK-28U：Full-load auxiliary diesel generation tests confirm that Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre provides a backup generator continuous runtime of 48 h under continuous emergency operation at full critical load.
PWR-BACK-H7B：Engineering testing of full-load auxiliary diesel units at Rhine-Danube International Expo Center indicates a backup generator continuous runtime of 72 h under full critical load.
